🔗 Share with Co-Coach

    

      Generates a self-contained HTML file with all your data embedded in it. Send this file to your co-coach — when they open it, all meets, records, athletes, and settings load automatically into their browser. No restore step needed.
      


      Note: This is a one-time snapshot. If you add more data later, generate a new shared file to send them.

📋 STAGING LAP PROTOCOL

      

        For accurate PP times, athletes should lap their watch twice at the hill:
      

      

        

          
✓ Tap 1 — At the start line

          
Press lap when arriving at the bottom of the hill. Stand and wait for the group. This creates the short staging lap the importer uses to find the effort.

        

        

          
✓ Tap 2 — At the finish

          
Press lap when reaching the top of the hill. This marks the end of the PP effort and allows the importer to isolate the exact segment.

        

      

      

        Without a staging lap → GPS fallback is used → result flagged as ⚠ Review · verify in Final Surge and edit manually.
